title: the kinds-of-numbers energy matrix: switching power and energy per op of 51 (format, kind) tiles
registration: tools/claims-v3/kinds/E78.md (this file's prose). Frozen with the commit that adds them, before the Discord claim and the first launch. Any change after it is a dated amendment in E78.md, written before the data it touches. No band below moves after this commit.

card.pinned_by: the boot-time TDP 0 that et-board-clock-guard writes
card.knobs_written: none: no governor move, no TDP/threshold/clock set, no reset; the only management reads are `ettelem config` at both ends of every pass, inside the card lock, under timeout 10

kinds_spec.note: revision 2 supersedes 654ee2ce; int8 figures of revision 1 are never quoted

q130c_predictions.role: the empirical model (Q130C-M1), frozen; E78 scores it as its README and A1 say

q130c_amendment_a1.role: Q130(c)'s dated amendment, written before any E78 file existed: the scoring sets, R1-A1's interval, R3/R6/R9 readings

q130b_predictor_r2.role: the RTL predictor, revision 2, both variants (A: one toggle factor, B: per-format factors), in watts ABOVE fp32 zeros; PROVISIONAL (its bench fails a functional check)

q130b_predictor_r1.role: WITHDRAWN by Q130(b) r2 and kept as the record; NOT frozen as an E78 prediction and never scored

harness.binary: build/sparsity/host/sparsity_host in the aifoundry3 tree E67/E70/E79 ran from (~/aifoundry)

plan.anchor_rule: each anchor runs once in each of the three segments of every pass (three times a pass)
plan.tie: anchor_pi: the built-in fp32 --values pi, first and last in every pass (E60-E79's drift anchor)
plan.order: e78_common.pass_order: random.Random('E78|aifoundry3|<pass>') shuffles the 45 non-anchor kinds, deals them round-robin into three segments, adds the six anchors to each segment and shuffles each segment again; pass 7810 only puts fp32.a_randn_b_zeros first (Q130(c) R9)

launch.command: sparsity_host --test fma --type <type> --pattern none --values file:<tile> --shires 0xffffffff --per-shire 32 --seconds 4 --seed <pass+1> --stop-file <STOP> [--dump-tiles <first run of each item>]

windows.rail: the same windows, shifted by the rail's 0.2 s delay and deconvolved (tau 0.95 s)

card_budget.expected_breakdown: smoke ~1.5 min + 6 passes x ~10.7 min (65 runs + 2 burn-in at ~9.2 s a run: E79's measured 8.7 s a run (tools/claims-v3/hlp/README.md A3) plus 0.50 s for the quiet rule (tools/claims-v3/kinds/e78_desk_checks.txt [2]); sampler start, config reads, 15 s between passes)
card_budget.queue_rule: queue_e78.sh starts a full pass only if its projected end (the longest pass so far, 11 min before the first ends) is inside 85 card-minutes of the queue's start and before 19:15 PDT; with fewer than 4 passes done it runs a tier-1-only pass if that fits inside 88 card-minutes and the deadline; otherwise it stops. A pass in flight is never cut
card_budget.deadline_local: 19:15 PDT (card runs must end by ~19:30 PDT)
card_budget.below_minimum: fewer than 4 kept passes: every rule is reported NOT SCORED, never passed

analysis.primary_quantity: D(type, kind) = p80(kind) - Zhat_type(t0): switching power over the type's own zero-data level, Zhat the type's zeros anchor interpolated linearly in time within the pass; one value per (pass, kind), mean over passes, 95% = t(0.975, n-1) x the between-pass SE

also.D32: the same over fp32's zeros (Q130(b) r2's reference)
also.S: p80 - idle80 per run: switching power over idle, the idle bracket in front of the same run
also.rail: Drail and Srail on the deconvolved minion rail, beside the board arm, never instead of it
also.energy: pJ per op = 1e12 x W / R, R the host-record work rate in the power window (minion-ops/s); per MAC = / 4096 (fp32), 8192 (fp16), 16384 (int8); per flop = / (2 x MACs) for fp32 and fp16; duty = R / (600 MHz x 1024 / cycles_per_op) reported beside (expected ~0.996)
also.heat: dT_win = the die reading's mean over the power window minus the launch reading

leak.primary: auto (the median within-run slope of runs heating >= 1 C, as E70/E79)
leak.arm_source: E71's measured aifoundry3 idle slope; and no correction
leak.verdicts: every rule is scored at the primary; the arms' verdicts are reported beside

rail_model.source: fitted on E79's ten committed passes before any E78 data (tools/claims-v3/kinds/e78_desk_checks.txt [3]): rail = a + c x IIR_tau(board(t - d)), tau median 0.950 s (0.95-1.00), d 0.2 s in every pass, c median 0.810 (0.800-0.829), rms 0.302-0.409 W against 3.259-4.047 W with no lag

analysis.idle_bracket_basis: E79's committed passes (tools/claims-v3/kinds/e78_desk_checks.txt): board power falls to idle within 0.2 s of a process ending (a run's last 100 ms bin 34.8 W, +100 ms 26.33 W, +2 s 26.05 W; [1]), but in 109 of E79's 480 runs (22.7%) the bracket [t0-1.2, t0-0.2) began before the previous process had ended (median gap 1.91 s, p10 0.21 s; [2]): that is E79 A7's contamination. The quiet rule (2.0 s) makes the bracket begin >= 0.8 s after the previous process; on E79's gaps it would have added 495 ms a run on average ([2])

run_gates.clock: every sample of the power window at 600 MHz
run_gates.voltage: window mean within +-3 mV of the pass median
run_gates.launch: heated to >= 59 C, spawned at a reading of 58 C (within 0.5 C), >= 2.0 s quiet
run_gates.records: every launch record ok; every record's cycles_per_op within 0.5% of 546 / 546 / 318
run_gates.window: >= 15 telemetry samples in the power window, no gap > 0.5 s, and launch records covering it: the work done there >= 0.97 of 600 MHz x 1024 / cycles_per_op
run_gates.tile: the tile the host dumped on the item's first run in the pass equals kinds.json's sha256
run_gates.idle_bracket_valid_for_S: >= 8 samples, starting >= 0.8 s after the previous process, reading within 1.5 C of the launch reading

pass_gates.failed_runs: more than 2 runs fail a run gate
pass_gates.zero_line: a type's zeros anchor's middle run departs > 0.25 W from the line through its first and third
pass_gates.zero_range: a type's zeros anchor spans > 0.60 W, or anchor_pi drifts > 0.60 W first to last
pass_gates.random_range: a random anchor (fp32/fp16 randn, int8 full) spans > 1.0 W
pass_gates.config: ettelem config reads TDP other than 0 or threshold other than 65 at either end: reported separately, not pooled
pass_gates.basis: E79's anchor_pi drifted 0.08-0.53 W first to last in a pass (its 0.3 W gate set 2 of 10 passes aside), E70's 0.03-0.24 W (tools/claims-v3/kinds/e78_desk_checks.txt [4]); E78 corrects drift by interpolating three zeros a pass, so its gate only catches drift too large or too bent to interpolate

analysis.unit_of_replication: the pass; never samples inside one burst
analysis.resolution: a quantity with fewer than 3 kept passes is unresolved and its rules are NOT SCORED

E78-R1.name: rank
E78-R1.what: Spearman rho of predicted against measured switching power within each type
E78-R1.sets: Q130(c) A1's out-of-sample kinds (amendment-a1.json scoring_sets_a1.R1_R2_out_of_sample_kinds): fp32 15, fp16 14, int8 13
E78-R1.defense: with 13-15 kinds rho = 0.80 rejects no association at p < 0.001 and allows only local swaps; Q130(c) registered 0.90 for itself, which is scored separately as its own R2

E78-R2.name: accuracy
E78-R2.what: rms of (measured - predicted) switching power within each type, out of sample
E78-R2.pass_if: rms <= bound in each type, separately
E78-R2.defense: 8-9% of the random-data step Q130(c) predicts for fp32 and fp16 (24.2 and 22.3 W) and 14% of int8's (7.1 W); 1.4x the clean out-of-sample fp32 score Q130(c)'s A1 computed (1.46 W)

E78-R3a.name: one-sided zeros
E78-R3a.statistic: D(kind) / D(ref), per pass, mean over passes
E78-R3a.pass_if: mean <= 0.15 (per cell; the 95% interval says whether the verdict is resolved)
E78-R3a.defense: every lane is gated (kinds.json gated 1.000) while one operand bus keeps moving; Q130(c)'s gate arm says 0, its bus arm 0.21-0.45x randn in fp32 and fp16 (0.21-0.27x with A1's zero products unsigned; fp32 5.19/7.30 and 6.64/10.78 W): 0.15 sits between them. int8 a_zeros_b_full is non-discriminating (both arms <= 0.11x) and is reported, not used to choose an arm

E78-R3b.name: sparse90
E78-R3b.defense: 90% of the elements zero gates 99.2 / 96.1 / 82.2% of the lane-cycles (kinds.json); gate arm 0.02 / 0.05 / 0.11x, bus arm 0.23-0.31x: at most a quarter of random data's switching should survive

E78-R3c.name: magnitude does not matter
E78-R3c.pass_if: both means inside [1/1.10, 1.10]; max/min of the three means reported
E78-R3c.defense: sigma 2^-10, 1 and 2^10 flip 82,244 / 82,214 / 84,896 operand bits an op (max/min 1.033); a 10% band is three times that spread: bits matter, magnitude does not

E78-R3d.name: fewer mantissa bits cost less
E78-R3d.statistic: per-pass paired differences d1 = D(fp16grid) - D(bf16trunc), d2 = D(randn) - D(fp16grid)
E78-R3d.defense: operand bits 34,980 < 43,136 < 82,214 an op; Q130(c) predicts 23.26 < 23.95 < 24.21 W (frozen), Q130(b) r2 15.02 < 17.32 < 24.20 W: the size of the steps separates the models

E78-R3e.name: order alone
E78-R3e.rule_verdict: PASS if every cell passes; FAIL if any fails; else INCONCLUSIVE
E78-R3e.also_reported: the power saving as a fraction of the base, beside the operand-bit saving (0.260 / 0.267 / 0.230) - how much of the bus saving reaches the watts
E78-R3e.defense: identical operand multisets, verified word by word (kinds.json): only the stream order differs; Q130(c) predicts a 6 / 4 / 16% saving

E78-R3f.name: static bits are free
E78-R3f.fail_if: the 95% interval lies entirely outside it
E78-R3f.defense: 0xFF bytes (every bit set) against 0x01, neither moving, neither gated, the same accumulator walk (+64 an op); E67's six constant routes spanned 0.33-0.42 W in fp32 (docs/reports/data/2026-10-27-e67-a-side-bit-prices/README.md), so 0.30 W is below what route alone has produced and 16% of int8's whole lane-on step (E79: 1.834 W)

E78-R3g.name: no pair gate in fp16
E78-R3g.pass_if: mean >= 0.40: one zero in a two-term pair does not gate the update
E78-R3g.defense: the zero test is one 32-bit word (vpu_ctrl.v:1229-1234), which never fires on this tile (gated 0.000), and E36 measured the chip computing the plain sum; not gated, Q130(c) predicts 0.84-0.94x and the operand bits are 0.86x randn's; gated, it would sit with the fully gated kinds at 0-0.3x. 0.40 separates the two with margin on both sides

E78-R3h.name: a zero is worth most in fp32 and least in int8
E78-R3h.statistic: rho_t = D(sparse50) / D(random_t) per pass and type; d1 = rho_fp16 - rho_fp32, d2 = rho_int8 - rho_fp16, paired within the pass
E78-R3h.defense: the same 50% element sparsity gates 0.774 / 0.414 / 0.070 of the lane-cycles (the RTL's gate rule on the tiles, kinds.json); Q130(c) predicts 0.39 / 0.70 / 0.85, r2 0.23 / 0.55 / 0.92

E78-R3i.name: the gate sees words
E78-R3i.defense: word sparsity gates 0.760 / 0.644 against element sparsity's 0.414 / 0.070 at the same 50%; Q130(c)'s R3 asks for >= 2.0 W and is scored separately

E78-R4.name: replication on this card

pi_builtin_vs_file.why: the same bytes (0x40490FDB) from the host's fill and from a file

E78-R4.defense: same card, clock, voltage and protocol as E67 (27 Oct) and E79 (this morning); E70's constant anchors reproduced E67's within 0.4 W

E78-R5.name: instrument checks (reported, not predictions)

checks.rail_tau: the rail's lag re-fitted on E78's own passes, median within [0.80, 1.15] s
checks.duty: R / (600 MHz x 1024 / cycles_per_op) within [0.990, 1.000] for every kind
checks.carryover: |slope| of a run's residual on the previous run's switching <= 0.01 W/W or < 3 SE
checks.tie_dump: the built-in pi tile the host dumps equals kinds.json's fp32 pi tile

E78-R5.consequence: a failed check is reported with the quantity it qualifies; it moves no verdict

q130c_scoring.as: Q130(c) README 'The registered rules' + Amendment A1 (A1.1-A1.9)

C-R1.rule: E78: the measured switching power over the type's own zeros level is inside `switching_w_ci95` for at least 70% of the fp32 kinds run, and at least 50% of the fp16 and int8 kinds.
C-R1.a1: scored over the out-of-sample kinds only (A1.3) on the frozen switching_w_ci95; R1-A1 on interval_a1.switching_w_ci95_a1 beside it; the all-kinds score beside both

C-R2.rule: E78: the ORDER is right -- Spearman correlation of predicted against measured switching power >= 0.90 within each format, over every kind run.
C-R2.a1: over the out-of-sample kinds only (A1.3); all kinds beside

C-R3.rule: E78: the gate's signature.  (sparse50 - wsparse50) switching power is >= 2 W in BOTH fp16 and int8 (wsparse50 gates more, so it must cost less), and |fp32 sparse50 - fp32 wsparse50| <= 1.0 W, because in fp32 element sparsity IS word sparsity and the two are one kind.
C-R3.a1: fp32 clause dropped (A1.1); fp16 and int8 clauses >= 2.0 W; say whether int8's difference favours the frozen 2.79 W or zero-products-unsigned 1.73 W (A1.2)

C-R4.rule: E78: int8 (ones - zeros) switching power <= 2.0 W, against fp32's 8.555 W.  This is the sharpest structural prediction in this file and the one most likely to fail, because it rests on a single E64 run per point (+- 1.19 W).

C-R6.rule: E78: the product-sign term is real.  fp32 `neg_ones` costs within 1 W of `ones` (no sign CHANGE: every element is -1.0, so the product's sign never moves), while int8 `ternary` and `highbit`, whose signs do change, cost at least 1 W more than int8 `ones`.
C-R6.a1: read as random sign patterns against a constant (A1.6)

C-R9.rule: E78: the gate's reach.  fp32 `a_randn_b_zeros` is 100% gated by the B side while its A operand bus keeps moving (27,920 bits an op).  The `gate` arm says it costs ~0 W over zeros; the `bus` arm says it costs several watts.  Whichever E78 measures SELECTS the arm, and every kind's `switching_w_alt_gating_arm` is this file's prediction under the other one.  This is the single most informative cell in the matrix and E78 should run it first.
C-R9.select: the arm nearer the measured D(fp32.a_randn_b_zeros); boundary 2.60 W (midway between the gate arm and A1's bus arm); pass 7810's reading, where it runs first, is reported beside the mean

q130c_scoring.also: every kind's measured D beside its frozen switching_w_600mhz_a3, ci95, ci95_a1 and switching_w_alt_gating_arm; E78 reports each type's own zero-data level (S of the type's zeros) as Q130(c)'s for_integration asks

q130b_scoring.as: Q130(b) r2's README section 5: every cell an error in watts ABOVE fp32 zeros, both variants, never a ratio
q130b_scoring.per_kind: error = predicted dW_above_fp32_zeros - measured D32; z = error / sqrt(sigma_W^2 + se(D32)^2)
q130b_scoring.per_type: rms error, mean error, the fraction with |z| <= 2; E78-R1 and E78-R2 applied on the same sets
q130b_scoring.refit: g per format on E78's own anchors, g_t = D(t.ones) / (4096 x R(t.ones)) live slot-cycles a second, reported as a ratio to fp32's (r2's held-out E64 values: fp16 0.95 +- 0.10, int8 0.037 +- 0.048)
q130b_scoring.int8_zero_level: D32(int8.zeros): E64 put int8 zeros 0.68 +- 0.51 W above fp32 zeros (r2 predicts 0.00)

fp32.ones.source: E67 hl.json cards.aifoundry3.anchors: anchor_ones - anchor_zeros (built-in values, 27 Oct)

fp32.randn.source: E67 hl.json: anchor_randn - anchor_zeros (kernel-generated randn, a new draw each pass; E78 runs one fixed tile whose operand-bit count is 1.8% under its rule's 400-draw mean)

fp16.ones.source: E79 scored.json switching.fp16: -(zeros_minus_h0_W), a constant random-significand tile against zeros, paired per pass (E79 labels it exploratory); E78's constant is 1.0

int8.ones.source: E79 scored.json switching.int8: -(zeros_minus_h0_W), bytes of popcount 4 against zeros (exploratory in E79); E78's constant is 0x01

E64.why: the 23 Oct int8 cells join E78 only through these two names

joins.file_runs: a `--values file:` run prints nnz_a, a_elems and fp16_one_sided_pairs of a DISCARDED random fill and forces result 'unchecked' (main.cpp:587-591, :614): E78 ignores those fields, uses kinds.json's statistics, and verifies no arithmetic
